channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Democrats Nominate Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker of the House, Making History
item.description: The vote put Representative Hakeem Jeffries of New York in line to become the first Black lawmaker to win the post second in line to the presidency.

item.title: NPR: As overdose deaths fall, White House makes misleading claims about who deserves credit
item.description: In a statement celebrating the historic drop in drug deaths, the White House pointed to successes since President Trump took office. In fact, the biggest progress happened under the Biden administration.

item.title: BBC News: Inside the old gas pipeline where Ukraine is fighting an underground war with Russia
item.description: Watch: The BBC's Jonathan Beale joins Ukrainian forces taking the battle below ground and out of sight of Russian drones.

item.title: The Guardian: I jumped from a plane at 12,000ft. In mid-air, a friend’s knee collided into my neck
item.description: A group of eight trainee parachutists did the jump, and not far from the ground, disaster struck. Rob Bugden describes how he rebuilt his life after the accident that changed everything The skydive was going to plan. At…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Israeli court extends Gaza doctor Abu Safia’s detention without charge
item.description: An Israeli court extended the detention of Abu Safia nearly two years after Israel's army detained him.

item.title: Ars Technica: The "shameful" measles data that lost the US its elimination status
item.description: Measles became endemic in the US months ago—and it's only accelerating

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Rogue Agents Hacked His Company. Why Is Clément Delangue So Optimistic About AI?
item.description: The French CEO of Hugging Face, a mega-hub of open-source AI software, says the attack by OpenAI models earlier this year proved one thing: Humanity can’t let AI be controlled by the few.

item.title: WIRED Science: The US Lost Its Measles Elimination Status. It’ll Take Years to Get It Back
item.description: The highly contagious disease is spreading across the country, and “may even be gaining speed.”

item.title: WIRED Business: Inside Nvidia’s First Post-Jensen All-Hands: Pay Raises and More Equity
item.description: Interim CEO Collette Kress sought to ease employee concerns following Jensen Huang’s ouster, in part by promising to increase compensation.

item.title: The New Yorker: Will the New Democratic Majority Get Off the Ground?
item.description: After a wave of midterm wins, thousands of party operatives, elected officials, and Friends of the Pod gathered to do something unusual: celebrate.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: His Favorite Patient
item.description: After a double mastectomy, a plastic surgeon put my body back together — but he left my heart a complete mess.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: The NYC Neighborhoods Where It’s Smarter to Buy Than Rent
item.description: Rents and sale prices are so high that there’s just a handful of neighborhoods where it’s cheaper to buy than rent over ten years.
